reason: B is the better proposal because it extends prior 298–573 K creep work into a more service-relevant >1000 K regime, controls grain size, and links in situ deformation signatures to plastic strain and toughness rather than largely repeating the cited experiment. Its fragmented-partial-slip and recovery/recrystallization mechanism remains speculative and should be narrowed, but A neither isolates lattice distortion from microstructural differences nor goes materially beyond the prior WTaTiVZr–tungsten comparison.
